findings_qualitative.value: Redshifted 12CO jet is an extension of the NIR jet and curves beyond ~4000 au.

evidence.quote: the redshifted $^{12}$CO jet can be seen as an extension of the NIR jet

findings_qualitative.value: 13CO and C18O trace compact dense slow gas near the source rather than the jet.

evidence.quote: These tracers highlight dense, slow-moving gas likely associated with the envelope or cavity walls, rather than the high-velocity jet.
